title: Naomi's Unnamed Season
reflection:
Naomi returned from Moab and told her friends to call her Mara — bitter — because her season had turned in a way she hadn't chosen or scheduled. The text doesn't rush her through it. It lets her name what she's in before the story moves on.

Whatever this month's heaviness is, you're allowed to name it too, without needing to explain its timing to anyone, even yourself.
closing: God who let Naomi be Mara for a while, let me be honest about this season too. Meet me in the unnamed weight of it. Amen.

scripture.text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven.

title: Hannah's Bitter Prayer
reflection:
Hannah prayed "out of great anxiety and vexation," pouring out her grief before God with no set liturgy for it, no schedule Eli even recognised as prayer at first. What she released didn't come on any predictable timing — only when it needed to.

Let your own release come the same way today, however unpredictable its arrival. It is still prayer.
closing: God who received Hannah's unscheduled grief, receive what I release today, on its own uncertain timing. Amen.

scripture.text: Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

title: Sarah's Laughter
reflection:
Sarah laughed when told new life was still possible for her — not politely, but in disbelief, because her body's old timetable had taught her not to expect it anymore. And yet.

When renewal shows up today, however unscheduled, let yourself receive it rather than argue with it the way Sarah first did. It's allowed to surprise you.
closing: God of Sarah's laughter, thank you for this returning renewal. Let me receive it, even in disbelief. Amen.

scripture.text: He gives power to the faint, and to him who has no might he increases strength.

title: The Bleeding Woman's Twelve Years
reflection:
Twelve years she waited, with no schedule promising an end, only the persistence to keep reaching toward whatever hem of hope was in front of her. She didn't know which day would be the one that changed things. She reached anyway.

You don't need to know which day this waiting resolves. Reach anyway. That is still faith.
closing: God who felt her reach even in a crowd, feel mine too, in this unscheduled waiting. Amen.

scripture.text: But they who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles.
